Maple Grove Elementary - Family Newsletter
Week of March 2, 2026

Principal's note
Thank you to the families who joined our literacy night. We had 212 students attend and every
classroom shared a reading activity. This month we are focusing on attendance: students who miss
fewer than two days in March will be invited to a popcorn celebration on April 3.

Important dates
- March 6: Report card envelopes due back to the office.
- March 12: Parent-teacher conferences, 12:30 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. Sign up at the front office.
- March 18: Early dismissal at 1:15 p.m. for staff development. Bus routes run on the early schedule.
- March 23 - 27: Spring break, no school.
- April 3: Attendance celebration during the last hour of the day.

Picture day
Spring picture day is Thursday, March 19. Order forms went home in backpacks and are due the same
day. Online orders close at 9:00 p.m. on March 20. Students who do not order will still be
photographed for the yearbook.

Volunteers needed
The book fair runs March 16 - 20. We need two volunteers per shift. If you can help, contact the
office by Friday, March 13 and complete the district volunteer form, which takes about ten minutes.

Health office reminder
Please send a change of clothes for students in grades K-2. The health office also needs
permission forms on file before giving any over-the-counter medication.

Lost and found
Items left unclaimed by March 27 will be donated.

Questions
Call the front office between 8:00 a.m. and 3:30 p.m.

This newsletter is a synthetic example for testing. Names and dates are fictional.
